messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

streaming_service.description: Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

message.reasoning: The user wants to find Netflix list of "Six Feet Under" (六人行) shows and ratings, and Hulu ratings for "Our Office" (maybe "The Office") and "Stranger Things" (怪奇物語). They want sorted by rating. We need to call the function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings. Provide streaming_service and show_list. For Netflix: show_list ["六人行"]? But the show name is "Six Feet Under" in Chinese "六人行". For Hulu: show_list ["我們的辦公室", "怪奇物語"]? Actually "The Office" is "辦公室" maybe "我們的辦公室"? The user wrote "我們的辦公室" which might be "Our Office" but likely "The Office". And "怪奇物語" is "Stranger Things". So we need to call function twice? The function expects one streaming_service and a list of shows. We can call twice: once for Netflix with show_list ["六人行"], sort_by_rating true. Then for Hulu with show_list ["我們的辦公室", "怪奇物語"], sort_by_rating true. Or we can combine? The function only accepts one streaming_service at a time. So we need two calls. Let's do that.
